comments.author: @Me__Myself__and__I
comments.text:
Yesterday I had an interesting thought.  Look at the world, so much major crazy s*** is happening.  AI xrisk, civil unrest, massive crime surges, massive protesting, major wars, renewed space race, etc.  And most of those could come to a head, nearly at the same time, in the next few years.  It feels like what happens near the end of a narrative AAA video game where everything at play is peaking before the game resolves.  Could we be NPCs in a futuristic video game simulation?

If so, who is the main player?  The answer jumped out: Elon Musk.  Who is the one person that is on record as trying to combat or at least somehow involved with ALL OF THAT?  Elon.  Tesla was created to fight climate change.  SpaceX is tasked with creating a human backup plan on Mars.  xAI/Grok/Tesla bot for AI.  X/Twitter is involved or central to much of the rest.  If this was a video game, he'd almost have to be the player.  Plus, who is most well known for saying our world is/could be a simulation?  Elon of course.

It all felt so absurdly fitting when I had these thoughts that I almost fell over from hysterical laughter.  Makes you wonder.
